text:
Psycho, I'm liable to go Michael, take your pick
Jackson, Tyson, Jordan, Game 6

body: There is a history of genius-level performances by individuals named Michael: Michael Jackson, a.k.a. the “King of Pop”; Mike Tyson, the former Heavyweight Boxing Champion of the World; and Michael Jordan, widely considered to be the greatest basketball player of all time.
This image is taken from the music video for Michael Jackson’s single, “Jam,” found on his November 1991 album, Dangerous.

Five of Jordan’s six NBA championships ended in the sixth of a seven game series. For example, his 1998 winning-shot in Game 6 against the Utah Jazz proved to be legendary. It’s worth noting that Jordan never played a Game 7 in the NBA Finals.
